name: dtcg-contrast
tagline: Gate WCAG 2.2 and APCA contrast on your design tokens.
description: A zero-dependency CLI and GitHub Action that checks W3C DTCG 2025.10 design tokens for WCAG 2.2 and APCA contrast, and auto-fixes failing colors in OKLCH.
features: Checks every foreground and background pair in WCAG 2.2 and APCA, in light and dark.
Auto-fixes failing colors in OKLCH while keeping the hue.
Runs as a CLI or a GitHub Action with no dependencies.
